info.description: Generated by tests/api/build-collection.js — do not edit by hand. Run with `npm run test:api`.

item.name: Archive cleanup is refused to a user who is not a WordPress administrator
Refused archive cleanup leaves the task of the deleted board

exec: pm.test('task of the deleted board is archived', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map((x) => String(x.id))).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('orphanTaskId')));

item.name: Admin removes archived tasks of deleted boards

exec: pm.test('task of the deleted board is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.deletedTaskIds.map(String)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('orphanTaskId')));
